dollar_basis: All costs in 2024 dollars (BEA GDP deflator, FRED A191RD3A086NBEA: 2022=118.023, 2024=125.428).

projects.description: One row per generator interconnection request in US transmission queues, through end of 2025 (LBNL Queued Up 2026). Generation, storage and hybrids only: load requests (e.g. data centers), distribution-connected and behind-the-meter projects are NOT included.
projects.source: LBNL & GridTracker, Queued Up 2026 Edition, CC BY 4.0

columns.name: project_uid
columns.description: Unique ID built here: entity|q_id, with #2, #3 added when the source reuses an ID.

columns.name: entity
columns.description: Transmission provider that runs the queue: one of 7 ISOs (CAISO, ERCOT, ISO-NE, MISO, NYISO, PJM, SPP) or a utility.

columns.name: q_id
columns.description: Queue position as published by the operator. Only unique within an entity.

columns.name: q_id_note
columns.description: Set when the source ID is unreliable (9 CLPT IDs were turned into dates by Excel).

columns.name: shares_q_id_with_other_record
columns.description: True when another record in the same entity uses the same q_id.

columns.name: region
columns.description: Standardized region: the 7 ISOs, plus 'West' and 'Southeast' for non-ISO utilities.

columns.name: is_iso
columns.description: True if the region is an ISO/RTO market.

columns.name: utility
columns.description: Utility name (same as entity outside ISOs).

columns.name: state
columns.description: Two-letter state.

columns.name: county
columns.description: First county listed for the project.

columns.name: county_norm
columns.description: Normalized county name used for joins.

columns.name: fips_code
columns.description: 5-digit county FIPS code (text). Joins to county_summary and eia_generators.

columns.name: poi_name
columns.description: Point of interconnection as written by the operator, including placeholders like 'Unknown', 'TBD', '138kV'.

columns.name: poi_name_clean
columns.description: poi_name with placeholders removed (unknown/TBD, bare voltages, generic 'distribution feeder'). Use this for grouping by location.

columns.name: project_name
columns.description: Project name. Missing for most requests.

columns.name: developer
columns.description: Developer name, not standardized. Only populated in ERCOT and NYISO in any volume.

columns.name: cluster
columns.description: Study cluster, where the operator studies requests in groups.

columns.name: service
columns.description: Interconnection service: NRIS, ERIS, NRIS/ERIS or Other. ERCOT is energy-only, so it has no NRIS/ERIS split; NYISO uses its own ERIS/CRIS terms.

columns.name: project_type
columns.description: Generation, Surplus, Upgrade or Replacement.

columns.name: q_status
columns.description: Current status: active, withdrawn, suspended, operational, unknown. 'active' includes projects with a signed IA not yet operating.

columns.name: ia_phase
columns.description: Standardized study phase. LBNL imputes 'IA Executed' for every operational project.

columns.name: ia_phase_raw
columns.description: Study phase as written by the operator.

columns.name: type_clean
columns.description: Resource type as LBNL standardized it, with hybrids combined (e.g. 'Solar+Battery'). 49 distinct values.

columns.name: type_group
columns.description: Resource type collapsed to a short shared list (also used in costs and EIA): Solar, Wind, Offshore Wind, Battery, Gas, Coal, Nuclear, Hydro, Geothermal, Oil, Solar+Battery, Wind+Battery, Gas+Battery, Offshore Wind+Battery, Other Hybrid, Other.

columns.name: is_hybrid
columns.description: True if the request has a second resource type.

columns.name: type_1
columns.description: Primary resource type.

columns.name: type_2
columns.description: Second resource type (hybrids).

columns.name: type_3
columns.description: Third resource type.

columns.name: mw_1
columns.description: Capacity of type_1 in MW.

columns.name: mw_2
columns.description: Capacity of type_2 in MW. Often missing for hybrids: LBNL's report imputes it, this public file does not.

columns.name: mw_3
columns.description: Capacity of type_3 in MW.

columns.name: mw_total
columns.description: mw_1 + mw_2 + mw_3. Undercounts hybrid storage where mw_2 is missing. Null for the 16 requests with negative mw_1.

columns.name: mw_note
columns.description: Set when the source capacity is unusable (negative values, likely derates).

columns.name: q_date
columns.description: Date the request entered the queue.

columns.name: prop_date
columns.description: Developer's proposed online date at application. Often revised later.

columns.name: ia_date
columns.description: Date the interconnection agreement was signed.

columns.name: on_date
columns.description: Date the project began commercial operation.

columns.name: wd_date
columns.description: Date the request was withdrawn.

columns.name: q_year
columns.description: Year entered queue.

columns.name: prop_year
columns.description: Proposed online year.

columns.name: ia_year
columns.description: Year IA signed.

columns.name: on_year
columns.description: Year operational.

columns.name: wd_year
columns.description: Year withdrawn.

columns.name: days_ir_to_ia
columns.description: Days from request to signed IA. Null if either date is missing or out of order.

columns.name: days_ir_to_cod
columns.description: Days from request to commercial operation. Null if either date is missing or out of order.

columns.name: days_ia_to_cod
columns.description: Days from signed IA to commercial operation.

columns.name: days_ir_to_wd
columns.description: Days from request to withdrawal.

costs.description: Project-level interconnection cost estimates from LBNL's cost studies, unified across six files and converted to 2024 dollars. Each row is the cost from the most recent available interconnection study for that request.
costs.source: LBNL interconnection cost studies (MISO 2022, PJM 2023, SPP 2023, ISO-NE 2023, NYISO 2023, non-ISO 2026)

columns.name: cost_id
columns.description: Row ID.

columns.name: project_uid
columns.description: Link to projects.project_uid. Null when the cost row could not be matched.

columns.name: matched_to_queue
columns.description: True if linked to a projects row.

columns.name: entity
columns.description: Queue entity (MISO, PJM, SPP, ISO-NE, NYISO, BPA, Duke, PacifiCorp).

columns.name: cost_q_id
columns.description: Queue ID as written in the cost file.

columns.name: source_file
columns.description: Which LBNL cost file the row came from.

columns.name: transmission_owner
columns.description: Transmission owner or balancing authority named in the study.

columns.name: state
columns.description: State.

columns.name: county
columns.description: County (ISO-NE, NYISO and non-ISO only).

columns.name: county_norm
columns.description: Normalized county name.

columns.name: fuel_raw
columns.description: Fuel as written in the cost file.

columns.name: fuel_group
columns.description: Fuel mapped to the shared type_group vocabulary.

columns.name: nameplate_mw
columns.description: Requested capacity in MW at the time of the study.

columns.name: service_raw
columns.description: Service type as written (labels differ by operator).

columns.name: study_type
columns.description: Study the cost comes from (Feasibility, System Impact, Facility, Cluster...). Later studies are more reliable.

columns.name: study_date
columns.description: Date of that study.

columns.name: study_year
columns.description: Year of that study.

columns.name: status_raw
columns.description: Status as written in the cost file.

columns.name: status_in_cost_file
columns.description: Status at the time the cost file was compiled (NOT current). Use projects.q_status for current status.

columns.name: status_data_through
columns.description: When the cost file's status snapshot was taken.

columns.name: queue_date_in_cost_file
columns.description: Queue entry date as written in the cost file.

columns.name: poi_cost_per_kw_2024
columns.description: Point-of-interconnection cost, 2024 $/kW (substation and line to the grid).

columns.name: network_cost_per_kw_2024
columns.description: Network upgrade cost, 2024 $/kW (upgrades deeper in the grid). Null for some ISO-NE rows.

columns.name: total_cost_per_kw_2024
columns.description: POI + network cost, 2024 $/kW.

columns.name: total_cost_musd_2024
columns.description: total_cost_per_kw_2024 x nameplate_mw, in millions of 2024 dollars.

columns.name: dollar_year_original
columns.description: Dollar year in the source file before conversion (2022 for ISO files, 2024 for non-ISO).

columns.name: poi_lat
columns.description: POI latitude (non-ISO file only).

columns.name: poi_lon
columns.description: POI longitude (non-ISO file only).

columns.name: voltage_kv
columns.description: Transmission voltage at the POI in kV (non-ISO file only).

eia_generators.description: Every US generator of 1 MW or more from EIA-860 2025 early release: operable, proposed, and retired/canceled, with plant location and balancing authority.
eia_generators.grain: one generator at one plant, in one status group

columns.name: plant_code
columns.description: EIA plant ID.

columns.name: generator_id
columns.description: Generator ID within the plant.

columns.name: status_group
columns.description: operable, proposed, or retired_or_canceled.

columns.name: status_code
columns.description: EIA status code (OP operating, SB standby, OS out of service, OA out of service but expected back; proposed: P, L, T, U, V, TS, OT; retired: RE, CN).

columns.name: technology
columns.description: EIA technology description.

columns.name: tech_group
columns.description: Technology mapped to the shared type_group vocabulary.

columns.name: prime_mover
columns.description: EIA prime mover code.

columns.name: nameplate_mw
columns.description: Nameplate capacity, MW.

columns.name: summer_mw
columns.description: Summer capacity, MW.

columns.name: year
columns.description: See year_meaning: operating year, planned operating year, or retirement year.

columns.name: year_meaning
columns.description: What the year column means for this row's status_group.

columns.name: planned_retirement_year
columns.description: Planned retirement year if reported.

columns.name: plant_name
columns.description: Plant name.

columns.name: utility_name
columns.description: Operating utility.

columns.name: state
columns.description: State.

columns.name: county
columns.description: County.

columns.name: county_norm
columns.description: Normalized county name.

columns.name: fips_code
columns.description: County FIPS mapped from the queue's county names. Null where no queue project shares the county.

columns.name: latitude
columns.description: Plant latitude.

columns.name: longitude
columns.description: Plant longitude.

columns.name: balancing_authority_code
columns.description: Balancing authority (e.g. PJM, ERCO, MISO, CISO).

columns.name: nerc_region
columns.description: NERC region.

county_summary.description: Precomputed per county: existing operable capacity (EIA-860) next to interconnection queue activity (LBNL). Use for siting and saturation questions.

poi_summary.description: Precomputed per point of interconnection (substation or line tap, as named in the queue): how many requests target it and what happened to them. Use for congestion questions.
poi_summary.grain: one POI name within one grid operator
poi_summary.source: derived from projects. POI names are not standardized across operators, so the same substation can appear under slightly different names.
